item.tib: tshe dbang rtog 'joms sprin gyi go cha'i sreg blug yig chung ye shes me dpung
item.coloph: de ltar rtog 'joms mkha' 'gro'i bsregs blug yi/ yig chung ye shes me dpung tshul 'di nyid/ lung zin DAk+ki'i dgongs bzhed mi ldog tsam/ lung dang rig pas gdab ste spel ba'i cha/ 'gal ba bshags shing phan sems dag pa'i dges/ 'gro rnams rtog grib mun pa bde legs ru (su/)dus gcig spel ba'i nyin byed mngon gsal te/ thams cad mkhyen dbang mi ring thob par shog de'ang lha bu spa ba spa thog gi rigs su skyes pa'i kho bo sems dpa' sur+Ya kha ri ba yis 'phral tsam bgyis pas yongs su dge bar gyur cig/
